scope: Local only; no production deployment and no live database migration
notification_fix: Learning assignment notifications use native course/studio destinations instead of the generic notification fallback.
Author links select the correct course and open the actual submission for grading.
Learner result links select the correct course task; web links select and scroll to its result.
Existing stored assignment notifications with course IDs receive a compatible native target.
grading: Manual grading remains the default for existing assignments.
Optional automatic grading supports single choice, multiple choice, ordering and fixed short answers.
Total assignment points are shared equally across questions; course author chooses pass percentage.
Long text and attachments remain manual; invalid automatic setups are rejected.
Evaluation uses server-side answers and a submission snapshot. Participant responses do not include solution keys.
Duplicate identical submissions preserve the result and do not duplicate notifications.
activation: Apply the migration only to a verified local database before using the updated backend. Then run an app build configured for that local backend. The release APK defaults to airmius.com.
manual_test: As author: course studio > task > enable automatic grading > choose supported question types and correct answers > total points and pass percentage > save.
As enrolled learner: submit wrong answers, inspect points and needs-revision status; retry with correct answers and inspect passed result.
As author: open submission notification and check the correct student response.
As learner: open grading notification and check task/result.
Try identical retry, stale assignment revision, unrelated account and revoked enrollment.
